Join the World Family Tree and See How We’re All Related

214,194,402

Profiles Connected on Geni

We are the World Family Tree

The World Family Tree on Geni is the one of the most definitive family trees for the entire world. It respects the privacy of living people while allowing millions of users to collaborate on their shared ancestry by constantly expanding and improving the tree. The World Family Tree currently has more than 210 million profiles and is growing rapidly.

Traditionally, genealogists have embarked on individual studies of their family history in the hope of preserving it for future generations. By combining all research into a single, collaborative tree, you can focus on discovering new information and pursue exciting new leads rather than wasting time repeating what others have already found.

Geni is Popular Worldwide

Devoted Researchers, Historians and Specialized Volunteers

Geni is a collaborative project, where everyone can make a significant contribution to the overall effort. We have over 210 million profiles in the shared World Family Tree and historians, educational professionals, researchers and people like you and me help to make Geni as complete and accurate as possible.

Geni has recruited volunteer curators from around the world to help resolve collaboration issues, maintain guidelines for historical profiles and assist tree-builders when they run into issues.

Translated Natively in Over 150 Languages

Other sites may rely on inaccurate auto-translation tools to fool users into thinking they support multiple languages on their website. Geni has dedicated volunteers that translate each and every word into their native tongue. While our goal is to have 100% translation over the entire site in over 150 languages, this is an ongoing process. As every new feature is released, each word, phrase and sentence is updated as volunteers get notified of pending new translations.

Geni is the Choice for Families, Historians and Researchers Around the World

The World Family Tree

Our core mission is to have everyone connected to the World Family Tree. Finding out you are related to historical figures, celebrities, or the person next to you is a great feeling. But it isn't easy!

Advanced Source Citations

Have a birth certificate? Citations allow other users to trust and verify profile data, making collaboration a much easier process.

Unlimited Profiles

Whether you are one of our Geni Pro subscribers or have a free Basic account, there is no limit to the amount of profiles you can create.

Largest Project Database

View, create or participate in genealogy projects from around the world. Our database contains over 90 thousand distinct projects dedicated to genealogy research.

Tree Matches

It is an incredible feeling when you find out there is another collaborator building a tree that matches yours. It is the first step in getting connected to the World Family Tree.

Discussion Groups

Need help or have a question about your genealogy research? We have a global community of users participating in our discussion groups. It is all at your fingertips.

Record Matches and Smart Matches™

Geni constantly matches profile data with our partner, MyHeritage, against billions of records in search of historical documents to support your work.

Consistency Checks

Did you enter a birthdate after a death date? Our software is constantly checking profiles to bring inconsistencies to your attention.

Price

Is it really free?

Yes! Our Geni Basic accounts are free. When you sign up, you are automatically enrolled as a Basic user. Basic accounts include unlimited profiles, Consistency Checker, photo and media uploads up to 1GB, resolving duplicate profiles, in-law and blood relationship paths, and access to projects.

Should I upgrade to Geni Pro?

For some users, a Basic account is enough. Others can benefit greatly from the tools offered with the Pro subscription in their journey to join the World Family Tree. Tools like unlimited Tree Matches, site-wide search of over 285 million profiles to find possible relatives, unlimited media uploads for archiving family photos and records, and other great benefits.

People Love Geni

Great idea to build a global family…
Great idea to build a global family tree. Building a tree with family members is great. I like that the tree is collaborative, if you see a person's profile where you can add more information or provide links to sources of information about them - just do it!
Great customer service, informative service
There were some discrepancies in our family tree that had been added years earlier. The Geni team helped me to set it straight and make our family whole again. I appreciated the fast customer service and the smart links to family members that made it easy to link my tree.
Bug was fixed very fast
I reported a bug, a button that didn't work as it should and get an answer after only 5 hours. They had identified the problem and had forwarded the issue to their engineers. After only one hour more, the problem was fixed! Really fast! Good work!
Geni is what you may be searching for
The staff of Geni are also very supportive and will do much to satisfy their users. A symbiotic relationship is what you will find if you hop on Geni!
A Helpful Company going above and beyond
I am very grateful to them. They were kind and helpful; not something often found in companies these days. Thank you Geni.
I have been informed of false info…
They explained everything clearly and took care of my issue immediately. Very impressed with this site! Thank you Geni.com.
Impressive Team work, impressive Company
It amazes me how a big organisation such as this could be so obliging especially in this day and age. Absolutely wonderful Company that I have been a part of for many, many years.

The World Family Tree

Why is the World Family Tree better than having a standalone tree?

At Geni, we see the world connected through each of our individual family histories. By combining all of our research into a single, collaborative tree, users can focus on verifying existing information and pursuing new discoveries rather than duplicating profiles and family trees that have already been built. Once you are connected to the World Family Tree you will constantly discover new information about your family thanks to other users who are constantly working to improve it. Soon you’ll discover your relation to a historic figure, celebrity or a close friend.

Sources and citations are included so the work of others can be checked and enhanced. If mistakes are found, you can fix them quickly on the World Family Tree, which is not possible with individual family trees that are controlled and owned by someone else. The World Family Tree allows identical profiles to be merged into one, reducing duplication and collecting the best information for all to share. Profiles support multiple languages so you can easily document names and biographies in your native language. The World Family Tree is also curated; a large team of expert volunteer Curators help other Geni users by answering their questions and ensuring the high quality of the tree.

Unlimited Profiles

All Geni users can add an unlimited number of profiles when building their family tree and creating them is easy when you use our Tree View interface. The more profiles and details you include, the more chances you have to connect and become part of Geni’s World Family Tree.

Advanced Source Citations

A source citation helps maintain accuracy and acts as genealogical proof among the profiles you contribute to your family tree. Whether it is confirming a birth date or residence, vital records like birth and death certificates, or census records are great examples of these types of source material.

You can upload an unlimited amount of citable sources and for those documents you might not have, Geni allows you to easily confirm data from other sources like MyHeritage’s Record Match and Smart Match™ with a data subscription to MyHeritage.

Project Database

Geni has one of the largest genealogy project-focused databases in the world. A Geni project groups profiles, descriptions, photos and discussions in one place. Many of our users use projects to focus on a part of history, a specific event in time, or gather information on a common interest. In fact, as you become part of Geni, you may find your own profile as part of a project or you might be invited to participate based on your knowledge or the location you were born. Participation is, of course, optional but remember that all of this information is available to you as a Geni member.

Tree Matches

Geni's core mission is to build the definitive family tree for the entire world by stitching together overlapping family trees. A Tree Match tells you that another user on Geni has a family tree that contains similar details to a profile that matches in your own tree. Merging or stitching together these trees can result in some powerful results, including discovering new facts, family members, as well as getting connected to the World Family Tree.

Discussion Groups

This is the place to go if you are seeking genealogy advice, resolving issues with profiles, or learning about new features. Start your own discussion or look through thousands of informative topics about anything genealogy related. You will find great information from experts around the world who use these discussion forums to tackle challenging genealogical questions.

Record Matches and Smart Matches™

The quickest way to discover new information in your family tree is through MyHeritage’s Record Matches and Smart Matches™. Automatic notifications of census records, marriage and birth certificates can be expected for the majority of Geni users. With a data subscription to MyHeritage you can quickly confirm those sources and update your family tree to improve the accuracy of your profiles and improve the quality of your family genealogy.

Consistency Checks

Our software constantly monitors profiles you create or are interested in. It hunts down common errors or other conditions that may indicate a mistake in the tree. These are important since more accurate profile data can lead to a bigger chance of matching other profiles on the site.

Any suspected errors are raised as inconsistencies and users are notified to double check profile data. As an example, one common mistake is accidentally entering a birth year incorrectly which may result in an alert referring to ‘Birth Date is after Death Date’ or a ‘Person is too old to be alive’.

Our system currently monitors 28 different inconsistency conditions to help you improve the accuracy of your profiles.
